def solve_cvrp(instance):
    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    customers = set(instance["customer_ids"])
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    dist = instance["distance_matrix"]

    def route_load(route):
        s = 0
        for c in route:
            s += demands[c]
        return s

    def route_cost(route):
        if not route:
            return 0
        cost = dist[depot][route[0]]
        for i in range(len(route) - 1):
            cost += dist[route[i]][route[i + 1]]
        cost += dist[route[-1]][depot]
        return cost

    def best_insertion(route, node):
        best_pos = 0
        best_inc = None
        if not route:
            return 0, dist[depot][node] + dist[node][depot]
        for i in range(len(route) + 1):
            prev = depot if i == 0 else route[i - 1]
            nxt = depot if i == len(route) else route[i]
            inc = dist[prev][node] + dist[node][nxt] - dist[prev][nxt]
            if best_inc is None or inc < best_inc or (inc == best_inc and i < best_pos):
                best_inc = inc
                best_pos = i
        return best_pos, best_inc

    def improve_route(route):
        if len(route) < 3:
            return route
        improved = True
        while improved:
            improved = False
            n = len(route)
            best_delta = 0
            best_i = -1
            best_j = -1
            for i in range(n - 1):
                a = depot if i == 0 else route[i - 1]
                b = route[i]
                for j in range(i + 1, n):
                    c = route[j]
                    d = depot if j == n - 1 else route[j + 1]
                    delta = dist[a][c] + dist[b][d] - dist[a][b] - dist[c][d]
                    if delta < best_delta or (delta == best_delta and (i < best_i or (i == best_i and j < best_j))):
                        best_delta = delta
                        best_i = i
                        best_j = j
            if best_delta < 0:
                route = route[:best_i] + route[best_i:best_j + 1][::-1] + route[best_j + 1:]
                improved = True
        return route

    def merge_routes(r1, r2):
        if route_load(r1) + route_load(r2) > capacity:
            return None
        variants = [
            r1 + r2,
            r1 + r2[::-1],
            r1[::-1] + r2,
            r1[::-1] + r2[::-1],
        ]
        best = None
        best_cost = None
        base = route_cost(r1) + route_cost(r2)
        for r in variants:
            c = route_cost(r)
            if best is None or c < best_cost or (c == best_cost and tuple(r) < tuple(best)):
                best = r
                best_cost = c
        if best_cost is not None and best_cost <= base:
            return best
        return None

    routes = []
    unserved = set(customers)

    while unserved:
        start = max(unserved, key=lambda x: (dist[depot][x], demands[x], x))
        route = [start]
        unserved.remove(start)
        load = demands[start]

        while True:
            feasible = [x for x in unserved if load + demands[x] <= capacity]
            if not feasible:
                break
            best_node = None
            best_pos = 0
            best_inc = None
            for x in feasible:
                pos, inc = best_insertion(route, x)
                score = (inc, demands[x], x, pos)
                if best_node is None or score < (best_inc, demands[best_node], best_node, best_pos):
                    best_node = x
                    best_pos = pos
                    best_inc = inc
            route.insert(best_pos, best_node)
            unserved.remove(best_node)
            load += demands[best_node]

        route = improve_route(route)
        routes.append(route)

    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        i = 0
        while i < len(routes):
            j = i + 1
            while j < len(routes):
                merged = merge_routes(routes[i], routes[j])
                if merged is not None:
                    merged = improve_route(merged)
                    routes[i] = merged
                    del routes[j]
                    changed = True
                else:
                    j += 1
            i += 1

    for k in range(len(routes)):
        routes[k] = improve_route(routes[k])

    return routes
